infotexts.talentdescription.ntsp_imadoctornota: Gain an additional percentage to Ranged Fire Rate and Melee Attack Speed equal to [skillpercentage]% of your surgery skill.
infotexts.talentdescription.ntsp_preventativepermi: The last person you ordered and ally(including yourself) within 6m gain gains [physicalresistance]% damage resistance and is less likely to suffer serious injuries.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_laststand: A good doctor should be able to heal not only others but also themselves. When dying, gain [base] + surgery skill × [multiplier] seconds of last stand: forced consciousness, stabilized blood pressure, no blood loss, and a steady heart rate. This is my final ripple! After it ends, you gain Aftermath of the Surge (max health -15%, curable at a medical clinic).
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_laststand: Forced consciousness; blood pressure, heart rate and blood loss are stabilized.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_laststand_aft: The price of holding on: max health -15%. Curable at a medical clinic.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_bonefixer: Fixing dislocations no longer requires opioid painkillers, and a failed skill check won't cause a fracture. The patient will still scream and collapse in agony, though — traditional techniques, pain included.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_firstaidtraining: Traumatic shock suffered during surgery is reduced by [traumashockresistance]%, and resistance to Neurotrauma is increased by [neurotraumaresistance]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_buff: Blunt force damage taken is reduced by [bluntresistance]%, and the chance of fractures (skull, neck, etc.) is reduced by [fracturechance]%.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_crustyseaman: For [duration] seconds after taking a hit, heal [bleedheal] bleeding per second on every limb (regular bleeding only; arterial cuts and other special bleeds are unaffected). [cooldown]s cooldown.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_implacable: When your vitality drops to 0, gain [base] + weapons skill × [multiplier] seconds of last stand: rapidly heal regular damage, stay conscious, +25% attack power, and cannot die from damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_implacable_amputa: On trigger, heals amputated limbs, fractures and dislocations; while active, cannot gain new amputations, fractures or dislocations.
infotexts.talentdescription.tesp_lastwave: After it ends, you gain The Last Wave (max health -20%, curable only at a medical clinic) and a brief stun. Whether the skill can trigger again depends on The Last Wave.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_implacable: Deathbed struggle: rapid healing, forced consciousness, +25% attack, immune to amputation effects.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.tesp_lastwave: The price of holding on: max health -20%. Curable only at a medical clinic.
